title.zh: Forging a Microsoft Edge Full Chain with Logic Bugs Only
title.en: Forging a Microsoft Edge Full Chain with Logic Bugs Only

current_state.zh: Security researcher Orange Tsai published a detailed write-up of a Microsoft Edge full exploit chain composed entirely of logic bugs, including a cross-site credential leakage that exposes a user's Microsoft email and a reverse chain from calc to Edge.
current_state.en: Security researcher Orange Tsai published a detailed write-up of a Microsoft Edge full exploit chain composed entirely of logic bugs, including a cross-site credential leakage that exposes a user's Microsoft email and a reverse chain from calc to Edge.
